data.title: Restart: spread and go
data.summary: After a goal against us the disc restarts in our endzone. Spread wide, then attack before they are set. C1 reads D3: if D3 cheats under, go deep; if D3 stays deep, take the under.

n1.title: Spread on the restart
n1.text:
The disc restarts on our goal line where it was caught. H2 sits 4 m to the break side as the dump. C1 is 9 m out in the middle, C2 16 m out on the break side. Nobody stands in the lane in front of the disc.
Use the setup time to spread, then go at stall 1, before the defense is organised.

bubbles.text: Check it in, then look C1 at stall 1.
Stay deep. The space behind C1 is the play.

n2.title: C1 jabs deep
n2.text: C1 takes two hard steps deep to make D3 turn. This is the moment D3 has to decide.

n3a.title: D3 cheats under: go deep
n3a.text: D3 jumps the under cut, which is the usual habit. C1 turns and runs into the deep space on the open side. C2 clears flat to the break side so it stays empty. H1 throws a leading flick into space about 1.3 s before C1 gets there.

bubbles.text: Throw to the space, not to C1.

n4a.title: Attack the endzone
n4a.text: C1 catches 6 m from the goal line with the defense scrambling. C2 attacks the front of the endzone on the break side; H1 and H2 follow up as resets.

n3b.title: D3 stays deep: take the under
n3b.text: D3 stays between C1 and the deep space. Then the under is open: C1 plants and comes back to the open side for a short flick. Gain 6 m and keep the disc moving.

bubbles.text: Catch and look upfield right away.

n4b.title: Give and go
n4b.text: H1 sprints up the open side the moment the disc leaves. D1 was marking on the inside and has to turn, so H1 is a step ahead and the lane is clear. C1 hits H1 in stride.

data.title: Dump and swing at stall 3
data.summary: The stall goes fast in 4v4. H2 moves for the dump at stall 3, behind the disc on the break side. Whatever D2 takes away, H2 takes the other thing.

n1.title: Stall 3: the dump moves
n1.text: H1 has the disc on the open side and the cutters are covered. H2 sits 2 m behind and 4 m to the break side. At stall 3, H2 moves. Do not wait for stall 6.

bubbles.text: Move at 3, not 6.

n2.title: H2 stands still
n2.text: Three seconds go by with nothing open downfield. Now it is H2's job.

n3a.title: D2 denies the up-line: dump back
n3a.text: D2 plays upfield of H2 to stop the up-line cut. H2 steps back and away for an easy backhand dump. The mark now has to run 4 m to set on H2.

bubbles.text: Back and away. Easy throw.

n4a.title: Swing before the mark sets
n4a.text: H2 throws right away while D2 is still getting to the mark. C1 comes under up the line. The disc moved from one side to the other in two throws and the stall restarted.

n3b.title: D2 sits behind: go up-line
n3b.text: D2 protects the dump. H2 cuts up the field and across into the open lane. H1 throws the flick in front of H2 for 6 m.

bubbles.text: Lead H2 into the open side.

data.title: Give and go
data.summary: Short throw to an under cut, then the thrower sprints upfield. In rec play the mark usually stops to watch the disc, which is exactly when to go.

n1.title: Disc on the open side
n1.text: H1 has the disc. C1 is set up 7 m upfield on the open side and C2 is deep on the break side, keeping the lane clear.

n2.title: Give: C1 comes under
n2.text: C1 cuts back toward the disc on the open side. H1 throws a short flick. Then H1 goes, right away.

bubbles.text: Throw, then sprint. No pause.

n3a.title: Go: D1 watched the disc
n3a.text: D1 turns to watch the throw and loses a step. H1 sprints up the field inside C1's mark, so nobody gets picked, then bends out to the open side. C1 leads the throw into space along the sideline. 10 m gained in two throws.

bubbles.text: Lead H1, throw early.

n3b.title: D1 sticks: come back for the dump
n3b.text: D1 runs with H1 upfield. H1 plants and comes straight back behind C1. D1 is now on the wrong side and H1 gets an easy reset.

bubbles.text: Fake up, come back under.

data.title: Ho stack 2-2 box
data.summary: Two handlers and two cutters in a box, middle lane empty. The cutter in front of the disc goes first; the other waits for the space.

n1.title: Set the box
n1.text: H1 and H2 side by side 7 m apart, C1 and C2 10 m in front of them. The middle stays empty so a cutter has room to run into it.

bubbles.text: Wait. Go when C1 clears.

n2.title: C1 jabs deep
n2.text: C1 sells the deep cut first. D3 has to decide.

n3a.title: D3 fronts: C1 into the middle
n3a.text: D3 bites deep to protect the endzone. C1 plants and cuts into the empty middle, toward the open side. Flick from H1 in front of C1.

bubbles.text: Plant hard, cut into the middle.

n4a.title: C2 goes now
n4a.text: With the disc in the middle, C2 attacks the open-side space behind D4. H1 cuts up as the next option.

n3b.title: D3 cheats under: up the line
n3b.text: D3 sits under to stop the middle cut. C1 keeps going up the line and H1 throws the flick past D3 to space.

bubbles.text: Lead it deep up the line.

data.title: Sideline trap escape
data.summary: H1 is stuck on the open sideline and the defense traps. On an 18 m field the trap is their best weapon, so the dump has to get to the middle fast.

n1.title: Trapped on the line
n1.text: H1 caught it 2 m from the sideline. The mark forces toward the line. H2 sets up behind in the middle, C1 is the up-line option, C2 is in the middle.

bubbles.text: Get to the middle for the dump.

n2a.title: D3 denies the up-line: dump to the middle
n2a.text: D3 stands on the sideline side of C1, so the up-line is gone. H2 moves into the middle, slightly behind, and D2 stays upfield to stop the up-line. H1 steps out wide and throws an around backhand past the mark.

bubbles.text: Catch it facing the middle.

n3a.title: Swing to the middle
n3a.text: H2 throws before D2 can set a mark. C2 comes under in the middle. The disc is off the sideline and the whole field is open again.

n2b.title: D3 plays inside: up the line
n2b.text: D3 sits inside to stop the cut toward the middle. C1 cuts straight up the line and H1 throws an around flick that bends back in along the sideline.

data.title: Empty endzone iso
data.summary: Keep the endzone empty except for one cutter on the goal line. If the defender fronts, go behind them; if they sit deep, come under and run a give and go.

n1.title: One player on the line
n1.text: H1 has the disc 6 m out. C1 waits on the goal line in the middle. C2 stays outside the endzone near the far sideline. H2 is behind as the reset. Only 3 m of endzone to work with, so keep it empty.

bubbles.text: Read D3. Front means go behind.

n2a.title: D3 fronts: hammer behind
n2a.text: D3 stands between C1 and the disc, which is common with so little depth to protect. C1 steps past D3 to the back of the endzone on the break side. A low throw would go through D3, so H1 throws the hammer over the top.

bubbles.text: Hammer over D3 into the back corner.

n2b.title: D3 sits deep: come under
n2b.text: D3 drops to the back of the endzone. Then C1 comes under to the open side for a short flick. C2 clears back out of the way so H1 has room to follow into the endzone.

bubbles.text: Clear out back. Give H1 the space.

n3b.title: Give and go into the endzone
n3b.text: H1 sprints into the endzone around the outside of C1, in the space C2 just emptied, so nobody gets picked. D1 watched the disc and trails. C1 throws it in front of H1 for the point.

data.title: Endzone: front fake, back cone
data.summary: Disc near the open sideline. C1 drives at the front cone to drag D3 there, then plants for the back cone. Only the near half of the endzone is live.

n1.title: Disc on the sideline
n1.text: H1 is 5 m from the goal line near the open sideline. C1 starts at the back of the endzone in the middle. C2 stays out of the endzone so the near half is empty.

n2.title: C1 drives at the front cone
n2.text: C1 attacks the front cone hard. D3 has to follow or give up the easy throw.
n2.option: C1 drives at the front cone

n3a.title: D3 sits in the lane: back cone
n3a.text: D3 sits in the lane to the front cone. C1 plants and goes to the back cone on the sideline. H1 throws the flick outside D3, along the sideline into the corner.
n3a.option: D3 sits in the front lane

bubbles.text: Outside D3, into the corner.

n3b.title: D3 opens to the back: front cone
n3b.text: D3 turns to protect the back cone. C1 keeps going to the front cone and catches it crossing the line.

data.title: Endzone: hammer threat
data.summary: One receiver in the middle, everyone else wide. The threat of a hammer over their defender pulls help away, which opens the flat throw to the side.

n1.title: Featured receiver in the middle
n1.text: H1 has it 7 m out. C1 stands in the middle at the goal line with D3 fronting. C2 is wide on the open side, 2 m from the sideline. H2 is the reset behind.

bubbles.text: Show the hammer.

n2a.title: D4 drops to help: flat to C2
n2a.text: H1 fakes the hammer to C1. D4 drops in to help on it. C2 cuts into the endzone on the open side. H1 throws a high-release flick over D4's reach.

bubbles.text: Go as soon as D4 looks at C1.

n2b.title: Everyone stays home: hammer
n2b.text: D4 stays on C2, so C1 is alone with D3 in front. C1 steps behind D3 toward the break-side back corner and H1 throws the hammer over the top.

data.title: Poach the idle cutter
data.summary: D4 leaves the far cutter to clog the open lane. It works until the offense swings away from the poach. Most rec offenses keep throwing into it.

n1.title: D4 sags into the lane
n1.text: C2 is far from the disc on the break side and not involved. D4 sags 4 m off C2 into the open lane, where C1 wants to cut. Everyone else stays on their player.

bubbles.text: Call "help" and watch C2.

n2a.title: C1 cuts into the poach
n2a.text: C1 cuts under into the open lane. D4 is already there, so the throw to C1 is a likely turnover. H1 holds and the stall climbs.

bubbles.text: Step into the lane, hands out.

n3a.title: Late dump: poach paid off
n3a.text: H1 has to dump at stall 5 or later. The offense lost ground and time. D4 drifts back toward C2.

n2b.title: They swing away from the poach
n2b.text: The offense recognises the poach and dumps to H2 on the break side, away from D4.

n3b.title: C2 punishes the poach
n3b.text: C2 cuts up the line while D4 is 4 m away. H2 throws before D2 gets back to mark. D4 needs about 2 s to recover, too slow. Lesson for D4: when the disc swings toward your player, get back first.

bubbles.text: Too late. Recover as the disc swings.

data.title: Mini cup zone (2-1-1)
data.summary: A 4-player zone: the mark (MK), one cup player (CP) 3 m off, a middle (MD) under the hammer space and a deep (DP). It baits slow throws.

n1.title: Set the zone
n1.text: MK marks H1 and takes the break side. CP stands 3 m off on the open side, close enough to block the short throw but outside the 3 m double-team circle. MD sits 7 m out in the middle, DP protects the endzone.

bubbles.text: You own the hammer space.

n2a.title: They swing around the cup
n2a.text: H1 throws across to H2 on the open side. The cup moves as a unit: MK sprints to mark H2, CP slides over, MD shades toward the disc.

bubbles.text: Sprint, set the mark on H2.

n3a.title: Zone reset
n3a.text: The cup is set on H2 against the sideline. Short options are covered and the stall is running. The offense needs another swing or a risky throw.

n2b.title: They go over the cup
n2b.text: H1 throws a hammer to C1 behind the cup. It hangs about 1.5 s, which gives MD time to close. A contested catch at best.

bubbles.text: Read the hammer, close on the catch.
